units.nameZh: 双色圆环转圈
units.descriptionZh:
结构：白色舞台中央只有一个空心双色圆环，没有文字、图标或图片。
尺寸与布局：外径52px，内径44px，4px实线边框，border-box；圆角50%，等于26px。固定尺寸，双轴居中，内外边距均为0。
色彩与质感：圆环内部透明，露出#ffffff舞台；上边框为#23232f，其余边框为#e4e5e0，形成深色四分之一圆弧与浅色环轨。没有渐变、阴影或模糊。
运动与状态：进入页面便顺时针匀速旋转，0deg至360deg，每圈900ms，linear，无延迟、无限循环；指针进入或移出均继续旋转，不跟随坐标。减少动态条件下，预览源码将动画关闭，深色弧停在上方。
响应与范围：1280×720和390×844 CSS视口下均为52×52px，无组件溢出；窄视口为iframe实测。此组件只表达不确定等待，没有任务进度、成功反馈、键盘操作或读屏播报。
units.descriptionEn:
Structure: One hollow two-tone ring is centered on a white stage, without text, icons, or images.
Size and layout: The outer diameter is 52px and the inner diameter is 44px, with a 4px solid border included by border-box. A 50% radius equals 26px. It has fixed dimensions, zero padding and margin, and is centered on both axes.
Color and material: The center is transparent over the #ffffff stage. The top border is #23232f and the remaining border is #e4e5e0, forming a dark quarter arc over a pale ring. There is no gradient, shadow, or blur.
Motion and states: It starts automatically, rotating clockwise from 0deg to 360deg every 900ms with linear easing, no delay, and infinite iterations. Pointer entry and exit do not change playback; it does not follow coordinates. The preview source disables animation under reduced motion, leaving the dark arc at the top.
Responsive scope: It remains 52×52px without component overflow in 1280×720 and 390×844 CSS viewports; the narrow case was measured in an iframe. This is an indeterminate visual wait indicator, without task progress, success feedback, keyboard actions, or screen-reader announcements.

Surface: #fff with an opaque #23232f shadow offset 8px right and down, zero blur and zero spread. The large block is 285×110px with a 6px radius and #eef0f2 fill. Responsive scope: the same isolated preview measures 294.8×177px inside a 390×844 CSS iframe viewport; padding and shadow offsets remain fixed.

units.descriptionEn:
Object and composition: A single native KBD keycap showing the ⌘ Command glyph, centered inside a light-gray rectangular key; no child element or icon.
Size and layout: Measured at 33.36×30px in a 1280×900 CSS viewport and 33.36×30px in a 390×844 narrow viewport. Width is content-sized; padding is 4px vertically and 8px horizontally; margin is zero.
Color, border and material: Fill rgb(243, 244, 246), text rgb(9, 9, 11), 1px solid rgb(209, 213, 219) border on all sides, 4px radius. The shadow is a 0 1px 2px outer shadow in rgba(0,0,0,0.05), preceded by two transparent zero-value layers. No gradient, background image or pseudo-element.
Typography and icons: The ⌘ CSS stack declares IBM Plex Mono, monospace; this browser did not load an IBM Plex Mono face and rendered through its generic monospace fallback, whose exact glyph file is unidentified. The label is 14px, weight 400 and 20px line-height on one line; no icon.
States and motion: This is a semantic keyboard-key label, not a control. Hover and mouse press produced no computed-style change; it cannot take keyboard focus; no loading, selected or feedback state applies. Touch-browser emulation emitted pointer/touch/click events but did not change fill, border or shadow; no animation was measured.
Responsive scope: In narrow-screen emulation the height remains 30px, measured width is 32px, and content does not overflow. Touch and reduced-motion results are browser simulations; this record covers the light documentation page and two measured viewports.

Size and layout: Measured at 110.89×48px in both 1280×900 and 390×844 CSS viewports; 21px horizontal padding and 0px vertical padding. Its 710×443px desktop flex preview centers it. Text remains one line without overflow.

States and motion: A page-level Tab sweep reached the button on press 82 with a 1px auto system outline. Enter and Space each generated a click event, but URL and label stayed unchanged. Hover background changes immediately; press scales the separate CSS scale property from default to 0.98 over 150ms with cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), returning on release. The touch emulation briefly scales while :active.

units.descriptionEn:
Structure: The neutral Dash example in the daisyUI Button documentation is a native BUTTON containing the single word “Dash”. It sits beside the Outline example, and .btn-dash supplies the border style.

Size and layout: At a 1280×900 viewport it measures 69.125×40 CSS px, has 16px horizontal padding and 4px corners, and sizes to its content.

Color and material: Its default fill is transparent with dark text and a 1px dark dashed border on the white demo surface. Hover adds a dark fill, pale text, a solid border and subtle shadows. The default computed shadow layers are fully transparent.

Typography and icon: The system sans-serif label is 14px at weight 600 with a measured desktop line height of 24.5px. It stays on one line and has no icon.

Motion and states: Color, border color, shadow and transform declare a 200ms cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) transition. Programmatic focus shows a 2px outline; pointer press moves the button down 0.5px. The state frames do not prove every intermediate pose was visibly distinct.

Responsive scope: At 390×844 it remains 69.125×40 CSS px with no label wrap; computed line height is about 24px. Touch and reduced-motion readings came from browser emulation, which still reported a 0.2s transition. This record covers one docs example only.

Structure: One native BUTTON.btn containing only the text “Default”; it has no child elements, icon, or generated decorative layer.

Responsive scope: The button stayed 123.5×48px without text overflow in a 1280×900 page and a 374×304 embedded viewport inside 390×844 browser touch emulation. units.descriptionEn:
Structure: The Action Card in Cloudscape’s documentation Playground contains a rounded white shell, transparent content layer, heading button, body copy and a blue chevron at the end of the header row. A pseudo-element paints the blue outline. The heading button’s transparent overlay spans the full card.

Size and layout: At a 1280×900 CSS viewport the card measures 564.45×80px with 16px rounded corners; outer and inner layers share the same box. At 390×844 the same node is 308×80px with no measured overflow.

Color and material: Default fill is rgb(255,255,255), text is rgb(15,20,26), and the 1px outline is rgb(0,108,224); no shadow or gradient is present. The loaded Open Sans heading is 16/20px at weight 700; body copy is 14/20px at weight 400.

Typography and icon: The button reads “Action card header”, followed by “This is the main content of the action card.” A trailing inline SVG chevron is 16×16px with a 2px stroke.

Motion and states: Hover transitions the background to rgb(240,251,255) over 180ms ease-out; press changes it to rgb(209,241,255), and pointer exit restores white. Keyboard Tab focus shows a 2px blue ring around the shell. A pale-blue background remained after a tap in touch-browser emulation; this is not a physical-device test.

Responsive scope: CSS viewports 1280×900 and 390×844 were measured; the narrow card is 308×80px. The exact card appeared in touch emulation after scrolling the lazy-loaded page.

units.reconstructionPrompt: Rebuild the measured Cloudscape Action Card with a relative outer group that follows its preview width: 564.453125×80px at desktop and 308×80px in the measured 390px layout. Use a 16px radius, white rgb(255,255,255) fill and a 1px rgb(0,108,224) outline painted by an absolute inset-0 ::after with pointer-events:none. Inside, keep a full-width content layer: a heading row with a 16×16px blue inline SVG chevron at the end, then the body sentence beneath; preserve a 16px title line and 14px body text. Load Open Sans; heading 16px/20px weight 700, letter spacing -0.08px; body 14px/20px weight 400. Render the heading as a native type=button; its absolute inset-0 transparent ::after overlay covers the shell and can trigger hover/active styles. Hover background rgb(240,251,255); active background rgb(209,241,255); transition background-color 180ms ease-out. Keyboard :focus-visible on the heading adds a 2px rgb(0,108,224) focus ring on root ::before. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, set transition-duration to 0s. Keep default content height 80px and allow width to follow the available content column. In touch emulation, a tap can leave the pale hover fill visible after release. Do not add navigation, submit behavior, shadows, gradients, pointer-tracking transforms, or any user callback absent from this docs example.
units.scope: Desktop Edge at 1280×900 CSS px, DPR 1, zoom 1. Same exact DOM node was remeasured after setViewportSize(390×844): 308×80px. In a separate 390×844 Edge hasTouch/isMobile context the first load showed zero candidates because the Playground was lazy-loaded; scrolling to the bottom and returning loaded exactly one matching root. A safe tap then invoked the nested type=button overlay, returned to the same URL without submission/navigation, and left the pale-blue hover background visible in this browser emulation. This is browser simulation, not a physical-device claim.

This informational DIV has no focus, pressed, disabled, loading, selected or feedback control. Under reduced-motion emulation animation-name is none.

Responsive scope: Checked at 1280×900 and in 390×844 browser mobile/touch emulation. The narrow layout wraps and grows taller while keeping content inside the Alert border. units.descriptionZh: 这是 Element Plus 官方 Alert 文档“自定义关闭按钮”示例中的浅绿 Success 提示条。它只有一个左对齐的标题“Unclosable alert”，不含关闭叉号、前置图标或说明文字。桌面 1280×900 视口下外框为 600×40px，390×844 CSS 视口下随示例容器缩至 291×40px，高度不变；四角 4px 圆角，内边距上下 8px、左右 16px。背景为 rgb(240,249,235)，可见标题为 rgb(103,194,58) 的 Inter 常规字重 14px/24px；外层 16px/22.4px 不是标题字体。四边没有可见描边，也没有渐变或阴影。源站实测悬停与按住时，底色、字色、透明度及尺寸均保持不变；目标虽声明 200ms 的透明度过渡，在这些动作里未见实际画面变化。根节点有 role=alert，但未做屏幕阅读器或完整无障碍合规测试。Element Plus 2.14.6 包的 MIT 代码许可经过单独核验，不能据此推断文档站部署版本或站点媒体的授权。
units.descriptionEn: This is the light Success alert in the official Element Plus Customizable Close Button example. It presents one left-aligned “Unclosable alert” title, without a close control, leading icon or description. At a 1280×900 CSS viewport the box is 600×40px; at 390×844 it contracts with its example container to 291×40px while keeping its height. It has a 4px corner radius and 8px vertical / 16px horizontal padding. The background is rgb(240,249,235), and the visible title uses regular Inter at 14px/24px in rgb(103,194,58); the root’s 16px/22.4px does not describe the painted title. No visible border, gradient or shadow was found. On the official page, hover and held press left its fill, text color, opacity and size unchanged. An opacity transition of 200ms is declared, but no visible change occurred in those sampled actions. The root has role=alert; screen-reader behavior and full accessibility conformance were not assessed. A separate MIT code offer applies to the verified Element Plus 2.14.6 package, without establishing the docs runtime version or media rights.

units.nameZh: Default · 实心按钮
units.descriptionZh:
结构：官方 Button 示例中的单个原生 BUTTON，内有一个 SPAN 文字层“Default”；DOM 无图标、图片或生成的伪元素。

尺寸与布局：1280×900 CSS 视口实测外框 80.281×32px；四边边框 1px solid，四角 4px 圆角；内边距上/右/下/左依次为 8/15/8/15px。按钮与 SPAN 均在容器内居中。

色彩与质感：默认填充 rgb(255, 255, 255)、文字 rgb(96, 98, 102)、边框 rgb(220, 223, 230)，盒阴影 none；透明色仍保留透明度，不解释为白色。

字体与图标：实际文字在 SPAN，计算字体 Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif；14px、500 字重、14px 行高、字距 normal；本实例无图标。

运动与状态：hover 后 background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) → rgb(236, 245, 255)；color: rgb(96, 98, 102) → rgb(64, 158, 255)；border-top-color: rgb(220, 223, 230) → rgb(198, 226, 255)；按住相对 hover border-top-color: rgb(198, 226, 255) → rgb(64, 158, 255)。常态声明 100ms ease 的 all 过渡；键盘焦点出现 2px solid rgb(160, 207, 255) 轮廓、偏移 1px。

响应与范围：390×844 CSS 视口复测外框 80.281×32px；两个视口中的 SPAN 字号及行高分别为 14/14px、14/14px。触屏和减少动态来自 Edge 仿真，未作实体设备或 WCAG 合规声明。
units.descriptionEn:
Structure: One native BUTTON in the official Button example contains a single SPAN text layer “Default”. No icon, image, or generated pseudo-element appears in this instance.

Size and layout: At the measured 1280×900 CSS viewport the outer box is 80.281×32px, with a 1px solid border and 4px corner radius. Top/right/bottom/left padding is 8/15/8/15px. The SPAN is centered.

Color and material: Default fill rgb(255, 255, 255), text rgb(96, 98, 102), border rgb(220, 223, 230), box shadow none. Transparent computed values remain transparent.

Typography: The actual text is in the SPAN. Computed font stack Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif, size 14px, weight 500, line-height 14px and letter spacing normal. This instance has no icon.

Motion and states: Hover changes background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) → rgb(236, 245, 255); color: rgb(96, 98, 102) → rgb(64, 158, 255); border-top-color: rgb(220, 223, 230) → rgb(198, 226, 255); a held press changes border-top-color: rgb(198, 226, 255) → rgb(64, 158, 255) relative to hover. Normal state declares an all-property 100ms ease transition. Keyboard focus shows a 2px solid rgb(160, 207, 255) outline offset 1px.

Responsive scope: At the measured 390×844 CSS viewport the outer box is 80.281×32px. SPAN font sizes are 14/14px and line-heights are 14/14px across desktop/narrow views. Touch and reduced-motion observations are Edge emulations, not physical-device or WCAG certification.

units.nameZh: Warning · 浅底描边按钮
units.descriptionZh:
结构：官方 Button 示例中的单个原生 BUTTON，内有一个 SPAN 文字层“Warning”；DOM 无图标、图片或生成的伪元素。

尺寸与布局：1280×900 CSS 视口实测外框 87.891×32px；四边边框 1px solid，四角 4px 圆角；内边距上/右/下/左依次为 8/15/8/15px。按钮与 SPAN 均在容器内居中。

色彩与质感：默认填充 rgb(253, 246, 236)、文字 rgb(230, 162, 60)、边框 rgb(243, 209, 158)，盒阴影 none；透明色仍保留透明度，不解释为白色。

字体与图标：实际文字在 SPAN，计算字体 Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif；14px、500 字重、14px 行高、字距 normal；本实例无图标。

运动与状态：hover 后 background-color: rgb(253, 246, 236) → rgb(230, 162, 60)；color: rgb(230, 162, 60) → rgb(255, 255, 255)；border-top-color: rgb(243, 209, 158) → rgb(230, 162, 60)；按住相对 hover background-color: rgb(230, 162, 60) → rgb(184, 130, 48)；border-top-color: rgb(230, 162, 60) → rgb(184, 130, 48)。常态声明 100ms ease 的 all 过渡；键盘焦点出现 2px solid rgb(243, 209, 158) 轮廓、偏移 1px。

响应与范围：390×844 CSS 视口复测外框 87.891×32px；两个视口中的 SPAN 字号及行高分别为 14/14px、14/14px。触屏和减少动态来自 Edge 仿真，未作实体设备或 WCAG 合规声明。
units.descriptionEn:
Structure: One native BUTTON in the official Button example contains a single SPAN text layer “Warning”. No icon, image, or generated pseudo-element appears in this instance.

Size and layout: At the measured 1280×900 CSS viewport the outer box is 87.891×32px, with a 1px solid border and 4px corner radius. Top/right/bottom/left padding is 8/15/8/15px. The SPAN is centered.

Color and material: Default fill rgb(253, 246, 236), text rgb(230, 162, 60), border rgb(243, 209, 158), box shadow none. Transparent computed values remain transparent.

Typography: The actual text is in the SPAN. Computed font stack Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif, size 14px, weight 500, line-height 14px and letter spacing normal. This instance has no icon.

Motion and states: Hover changes background-color: rgb(253, 246, 236) → rgb(230, 162, 60); color: rgb(230, 162, 60) → rgb(255, 255, 255); border-top-color: rgb(243, 209, 158) → rgb(230, 162, 60); a held press changes background-color: rgb(230, 162, 60) → rgb(184, 130, 48); border-top-color: rgb(230, 162, 60) → rgb(184, 130, 48) relative to hover. Normal state declares an all-property 100ms ease transition. Keyboard focus shows a 2px solid rgb(243, 209, 158) outline offset 1px.

Responsive scope: At the measured 390×844 CSS viewport the outer box is 87.891×32px. SPAN font sizes are 14/14px and line-heights are 14/14px across desktop/narrow views. Touch and reduced-motion observations are Edge emulations, not physical-device or WCAG certification.

尺寸与布局：1280×900 CSS 视口实测外框 84.109×32px；四边边框 1px solid，四角 20px 圆角；内边距上/右/下/左依次为 8/15/8/15px。按钮与 SPAN 均在容器内居中。

色彩与质感：默认填充 rgb(64, 158, 255)、文字 rgb(255, 255, 255)、边框 rgb(64, 158, 255)，盒阴影 none；透明色仍保留透明度，不解释为白色。

字体与图标：实际文字在 SPAN，计算字体 Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif；14px、500 字重、14px 行高、字距 normal；本实例无图标。

运动与状态：hover 后 background-color: rgb(64, 158, 255) → rgb(121, 187, 255)；border-top-color: rgb(64, 158, 255) → rgb(121, 187, 255)；按住相对 hover background-color: rgb(121, 187, 255) → rgb(51, 126, 204)；border-top-color: rgb(121, 187, 255) → rgb(51, 126, 204)。常态声明 100ms ease 的 all 过渡；键盘焦点出现 2px solid rgb(160, 207, 255) 轮廓、偏移 1px。

响应与范围：390×844 CSS 视口复测外框 84.109×32px；两个视口中的 SPAN 字号及行高分别为 14/14px、14/14px。触屏和减少动态来自 Edge 仿真，未作实体设备或 WCAG 合规声明。
units.descriptionEn:
Structure: One native BUTTON in the official Button example contains a single SPAN text layer “Primary”. No icon, image, or generated pseudo-element appears in this instance.

Size and layout: At the measured 1280×900 CSS viewport the outer box is 84.109×32px, with a 1px solid border and 20px corner radius. Top/right/bottom/left padding is 8/15/8/15px. The SPAN is centered.

Color and material: Default fill rgb(64, 158, 255), text rgb(255, 255, 255), border rgb(64, 158, 255), box shadow none. Transparent computed values remain transparent.

Typography: The actual text is in the SPAN. Computed font stack Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif, size 14px, weight 500, line-height 14px and letter spacing normal. This instance has no icon.

Motion and states: Hover changes background-color: rgb(64, 158, 255) → rgb(121, 187, 255); border-top-color: rgb(64, 158, 255) → rgb(121, 187, 255); a held press changes background-color: rgb(121, 187, 255) → rgb(51, 126, 204); border-top-color: rgb(121, 187, 255) → rgb(51, 126, 204) relative to hover. Normal state declares an all-property 100ms ease transition. Keyboard focus shows a 2px solid rgb(160, 207, 255) outline offset 1px.

Responsive scope: At the measured 390×844 CSS viewport the outer box is 84.109×32px. SPAN font sizes are 14/14px and line-heights are 14/14px across desktop/narrow views. Touch and reduced-motion observations are Edge emulations, not physical-device or WCAG certification.

色彩与质感：默认填充 rgb(245, 108, 108)、文字 rgb(255, 255, 255)、边框 rgb(245, 108, 108)，盒阴影 none；透明色仍保留透明度，不解释为白色。

Motion and states: Hover changes border-top-color: rgb(250, 182, 182) → rgb(248, 152, 152); a held press changes color: rgb(245, 108, 108) → rgb(196, 86, 86); border-top-color: rgb(248, 152, 152) → rgb(196, 86, 86) relative to hover. Normal state declares an all-property 100ms ease transition. Keyboard focus shows a 2px solid rgb(250, 182, 182) outline offset 1px.

Responsive scope: At the measured 390×844 CSS viewport the outer box is 80.797×32px. SPAN font sizes are 14/14px and line-heights are 14/14px across desktop/narrow views. Touch and reduced-motion observations are Edge emulations, not physical-device or WCAG certification.

Color and material: Default fill rgb(240, 249, 235), text rgb(103, 194, 58), border rgb(179, 225, 157), box shadow none. Transparent computed values remain transparent.

Typography: The actual text is in the SPAN. Computed font stack Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif, size 14px, weight 500, line-height 14px and letter spacing normal. This instance has no icon.

Normal state declares an all-property 100ms ease transition. Keyboard focus shows a 2px solid rgb(179, 225, 157) outline offset 1px.

结构：官方 Button 示例中的单个原生 BUTTON，内有一个 SPAN 文字层“plain”；DOM 无图标、图片或生成的伪元素。

尺寸与布局：1280×900 CSS 视口实测外框 38.094×20px；四边边框 1px solid，四角 4px 圆角；内边距上/右/下/左依次为 2/2/2/2px。按钮与 SPAN 均在容器内居中。

units.descriptionEn:
Structure: One native BUTTON in the official Button example contains a single SPAN text layer “plain”. No icon, image, or generated pseudo-element appears in this instance.

Color and material: Default fill rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), text rgb(96, 98, 102), border rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), box shadow none. Transparent computed values remain transparent.

Typography: The actual text is in the SPAN. Computed font stack Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif, size 14px, weight 500, line-height 14px and letter spacing normal. This instance has no icon.

Motion and states: Hover changes color: rgb(96, 98, 102) → rgb(144, 147, 153); a held press changes color: rgb(144, 147, 153) → rgb(48, 49, 51) relative to hover. Normal state declares an all-property 100ms ease transition. Keyboard focus shows a 2px solid rgb(160, 207, 255) outline offset 1px.

Responsive scope: At the measured 390×844 CSS viewport the outer box is 38.094×20px. SPAN font sizes are 14/14px and line-heights are 14/14px across desktop/narrow views. Touch and reduced-motion observations are Edge emulations, not physical-device or WCAG certification.

units.descriptionZh:
结构：官方 Button 示例中的单个原生 BUTTON，内有一个 SPAN 文字层“Small”；DOM 无图标、图片或生成的伪元素。

尺寸与布局：1280×900 CSS 视口实测外框 55.281×24px；四边边框 1px solid，四角 3px 圆角；内边距上/右/下/左依次为 5/11/5/11px。按钮与 SPAN 均在容器内居中。

色彩与质感：默认填充 rgb(255, 255, 255)、文字 rgb(96, 98, 102)、边框 rgb(220, 223, 230)，盒阴影 none；透明色仍保留透明度，不解释为白色。

字体与图标：实际文字在 SPAN，计算字体 Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif；12px、500 字重、12px 行高、字距 normal；本实例无图标。

运动与状态：hover 后 background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) → rgb(236, 245, 255)；color: rgb(96, 98, 102) → rgb(64, 158, 255)；border-top-color: rgb(220, 223, 230) → rgb(198, 226, 255)；按住相对 hover border-top-color: rgb(198, 226, 255) → rgb(64, 158, 255)。常态声明 100ms ease 的 all 过渡；键盘焦点出现 2px solid rgb(160, 207, 255) 轮廓、偏移 1px。

响应与范围：390×844 CSS 视口复测外框 55.281×24px；两个视口中的 SPAN 字号及行高分别为 12/12px、12/12px。触屏和减少动态来自 Edge 仿真，未作实体设备或 WCAG 合规声明。
units.descriptionEn:
Structure: One native BUTTON in the official Button example contains a single SPAN text layer “Small”. No icon, image, or generated pseudo-element appears in this instance.

Size and layout: At the measured 1280×900 CSS viewport the outer box is 55.281×24px, with a 1px solid border and 3px corner radius. Top/right/bottom/left padding is 5/11/5/11px. The SPAN is centered.

Color and material: Default fill rgb(255, 255, 255), text rgb(96, 98, 102), border rgb(220, 223, 230), box shadow none. Transparent computed values remain transparent.

Typography: The actual text is in the SPAN. Computed font stack Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif, size 12px, weight 500, line-height 12px and letter spacing normal. This instance has no icon.

Motion and states: Hover changes background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) → rgb(236, 245, 255); color: rgb(96, 98, 102) → rgb(64, 158, 255); border-top-color: rgb(220, 223, 230) → rgb(198, 226, 255); a held press changes border-top-color: rgb(198, 226, 255) → rgb(64, 158, 255) relative to hover. Normal state declares an all-property 100ms ease transition. Keyboard focus shows a 2px solid rgb(160, 207, 255) outline offset 1px.

Responsive scope: At the measured 390×844 CSS viewport the outer box is 55.281×24px. SPAN font sizes are 12/12px and line-heights are 12/12px across desktop/narrow views. Touch and reduced-motion observations are Edge emulations, not physical-device or WCAG certification.

Size and layout: At 1280×900 CSS pixels the outer box is 99.016×32px, with a 1px solid border and 4px corners. Top/right/bottom/left padding is 8/15/8/15px; the icon wrapper is 14×14px.

Color and material: Default fill rgb(255, 255, 255), border rgb(220, 223, 230), icon rgb(96, 98, 102), box shadow none. The text is 14px, weight 500, with 14px line-height. The SVG fills with currentColor.

Motion and states: Hover changes the fill from rgb(255, 255, 255) to rgb(236, 245, 255); held press uses rgb(236, 245, 255). The normal transition is 100ms ease; keyboard focus shows a 2px solid outline.

Responsive scope: The outer box is 99.016×32px at the measured 390×844 CSS viewport. Touch and reduced-motion results are Edge emulations; the icon button's accessible name is reported from the actual DOM.

units.nameZh: 大号 Large · 圆角胶囊按钮
units.descriptionZh:
结构：官方 Button 示例中的单个原生 BUTTON，内有一个 SPAN 文字层“Large”；DOM 无图标、图片或生成的伪元素。

尺寸与布局：1280×900 CSS 视口实测外框 77.922×40px；四边边框 1px solid，四角 20px 圆角；内边距上/右/下/左依次为 12/19/12/19px。按钮与 SPAN 均在容器内居中。

色彩与质感：默认填充 rgb(255, 255, 255)、文字 rgb(96, 98, 102)、边框 rgb(220, 223, 230)，盒阴影 none；透明色仍保留透明度，不解释为白色。

字体与图标：实际文字在 SPAN，计算字体 Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif；14px、500 字重、14px 行高、字距 normal；本实例无图标。

运动与状态：hover 后 background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) → rgb(236, 245, 255)；color: rgb(96, 98, 102) → rgb(64, 158, 255)；border-top-color: rgb(220, 223, 230) → rgb(198, 226, 255)；按住相对 hover border-top-color: rgb(198, 226, 255) → rgb(64, 158, 255)。常态声明 100ms ease 的 all 过渡；键盘焦点出现 2px solid rgb(160, 207, 255) 轮廓、偏移 1px。

响应与范围：390×844 CSS 视口复测外框 77.922×40px；两个视口中的 SPAN 字号及行高分别为 14/14px、14/14px。触屏和减少动态来自 Edge 仿真，未作实体设备或 WCAG 合规声明。
units.descriptionEn:
Structure: One native BUTTON in the official Button example contains a single SPAN text layer “Large”. No icon, image, or generated pseudo-element appears in this instance.

Size and layout: At the measured 1280×900 CSS viewport the outer box is 77.922×40px, with a 1px solid border and 20px corner radius. Top/right/bottom/left padding is 12/19/12/19px. The SPAN is centered.

Color and material: Default fill rgb(255, 255, 255), text rgb(96, 98, 102), border rgb(220, 223, 230), box shadow none. Transparent computed values remain transparent.

Typography: The actual text is in the SPAN. Computed font stack Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif, size 14px, weight 500, line-height 14px and letter spacing normal. This instance has no icon.

Motion and states: Hover changes background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255) → rgb(236, 245, 255); color: rgb(96, 98, 102) → rgb(64, 158, 255); border-top-color: rgb(220, 223, 230) → rgb(198, 226, 255); a held press changes border-top-color: rgb(198, 226, 255) → rgb(64, 158, 255) relative to hover. Normal state declares an all-property 100ms ease transition. Keyboard focus shows a 2px solid rgb(160, 207, 255) outline offset 1px.

Responsive scope: At the measured 390×844 CSS viewport the outer box is 77.922×40px. SPAN font sizes are 14/14px and line-heights are 14/14px across desktop/narrow views. Touch and reduced-motion observations are Edge emulations, not physical-device or WCAG certification.

Size and layout: At the measured 1280×900 CSS viewport the outer box is 62.094×32px, with a 0px solid border and 4px corner radius. Top/right/bottom/left padding is 8/15/8/15px. The SPAN is centered.

Color and material: Default fill rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), text rgb(96, 98, 102), border rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), box shadow none. Transparent computed values remain transparent.

Typography: The actual text is in the SPAN. Computed font stack Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif, size 14px, weight 500, line-height 14px and letter spacing normal. This instance has no icon.

Motion and states: Hover changes background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) → rgb(245, 247, 250); a held press changes background-color: rgb(245, 247, 250) → rgb(240, 242, 245) relative to hover. Normal state declares an all-property 100ms ease transition. Keyboard focus shows a 2px solid rgb(160, 207, 255) outline offset 1px.

Responsive scope: At the measured 390×844 CSS viewport the outer box is 62.094×32px. SPAN font sizes are 14/14px and line-heights are 14/14px across desktop/narrow views. Touch and reduced-motion observations are Edge emulations, not physical-device or WCAG certification.

units.nameZh: info · 浅底文字按钮
units.descriptionZh:
结构：官方 Button 示例中的单个原生 BUTTON，内有一个 SPAN 文字层“info”；DOM 无图标、图片或生成的伪元素。

尺寸与布局：1280×900 CSS 视口实测外框 55.344×32px；四边边框 0px solid，四角 4px 圆角；内边距上/右/下/左依次为 8/15/8/15px。按钮与 SPAN 均在容器内居中。

色彩与质感：默认填充 rgb(245, 247, 250)、文字 rgb(144, 147, 153)、边框 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)，盒阴影 none；透明色仍保留透明度，不解释为白色。

字体与图标：实际文字在 SPAN，计算字体 Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif；14px、500 字重、14px 行高、字距 normal；本实例无图标。

运动与状态：hover 后 background-color: rgb(245, 247, 250) → rgb(240, 242, 245)；按住相对 hover background-color: rgb(240, 242, 245) → rgb(235, 237, 240)。常态声明 100ms ease 的 all 过渡；键盘焦点出现 2px solid rgb(200, 201, 204) 轮廓、偏移 1px。

响应与范围：390×844 CSS 视口复测外框 55.344×32px；两个视口中的 SPAN 字号及行高分别为 14/14px、14/14px。触屏和减少动态来自 Edge 仿真，未作实体设备或 WCAG 合规声明。

units.nameZh: primary · 文字按钮

尺寸与布局：1280×900 CSS 视口实测外框 81.781×32px；四边边框 0px solid，四角 4px 圆角；内边距上/右/下/左依次为 8/15/8/15px。按钮与 SPAN 均在容器内居中。

色彩与质感：默认填充 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)、文字 rgb(64, 158, 255)、边框 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)，盒阴影 none；透明色仍保留透明度，不解释为白色。

字体与图标：实际文字在 SPAN，计算字体 Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", 微软雅黑, Arial, sans-serif；14px、500 字重、14px 行高、字距 normal；本实例无图标。

Responsive scope: At the measured 390×844 CSS viewport the outer box is 81.781×32px. SPAN font sizes are 14/14px and line-heights are 14/14px across desktop/narrow views. Touch and reduced-motion observations are Edge emulations, not physical-device or WCAG certification.
